data.one_liner: Widgets for infinite scrolling lists and grids
data.what_it_does: Provides InfiniteListView and InfiniteGridView that load more data when scrolled near the end. They mimic the API of ListView and GridView with added hasNext and nextData callbacks.
use_when: You need to display a large list or grid that loads data lazily from a network or database
You want a simple, drop‑in replacement for ListView/GridView with pagination support
avoid_when: Your list is small and static
You need complex scroll behaviors not supported by the widget
strengths: Easy to use, same API as standard ListView/GridView
weaknesses: Limited to list and grid layouts only
No support for custom scroll thresholds beyond a single value
No advanced features like pull‑to‑refresh or error handling
data.minimal_example:
InfiniteListView.separated(
  itemBuilder: (context, index) => Text('$index'),
  itemCount: _data.length,
  hasNext: _data.length < 200,
  nextData: loadNextData,
  separatorBuilder: (context, index) => Divider(height: 1),
);
